# UW Markdown

> Open, vendor-neutral standard for commercial real-estate underwriting. A `.uwx.md` record keeps typed deal facts, underwriting assumptions, calculation inputs, narrative, and provenance in one plain-text file. AI extracts and explains; deterministic code calculates and verifies financial results.

Canonical site: https://uwmd.org
Repository: https://github.com/UWMD-OSP/UW-Markdown
License: MIT
Current versions: https://uwmd.org/about/versions

## Start

- Quickstart: https://uwmd.org/tutorials/quickstart
- First record, by hand: https://uwmd.org/tutorials/your-first-uwmd-file
- UWX and UW Lite: https://uwmd.org/guide/lite-and-uwx
- Downloads: https://uwmd.org/downloads/
- AI guide: https://uwmd.org/ai/

## Tools for agents

- Validator in the browser (nothing is uploaded): https://uwmd.org/validate/
- MCP connector, read-only tools uwmd_validate, uwmd_verify and uwmd_explain_code: npm @uwmd/mcp (https://github.com/UWMD-OSP/UW-Markdown/tree/main/packages/uwmd-mcp)
- Skill, write a UWMD record: https://github.com/UWMD-OSP/UW-Markdown/tree/main/skills/write-uwmd-record
- Example records, one synthetic record per asset class: https://uwmd.org/examples/
- CLI: npx @uwmd/cli validate <file.uwx.md>, then npx @uwmd/cli verify <file.uwx.md>

## Contracts

- Format specification (Format 3.0, the only admitted version): https://uwmd.org/spec/format
- Protocol (4.0.0): https://uwmd.org/spec/protocol
- UW Lite specification: https://uwmd.org/spec/lite
- Schemas: https://uwmd.org/spec/schemas/
- Conformance: https://uwmd.org/conformance/

## Optional profiles

- HTTP: https://uwmd.org/spec/http
- OpenAPI: https://uwmd.org/spec/UW_HTTP_API_v1.openapi.json
- MCP: https://uwmd.org/spec/mcp

## Critical rules for AI

- AI extracts facts and writes narrative; deterministic code performs financial math.
- Preserve provenance and append-only supersede history.
- Preserve bytes outside a scoped edit.
- Rates are stored as fractions, not display percentages.
- Do not invent missing deal data.
- Verify before handing a record over: every stated metric is recomputed, and a wrong one fails.

Expanded index: https://uwmd.org/llms-full.txt
